name: Fate-chan wa Watasanai no
original_name: フェイトちゃんは渡さないのっ
source:
Fate competes in a lewd contest against Nanoha at a so-called social gathering that's actually a strip battle!
Yakyuken (rock scissors paper) gameplay. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088406.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在一场号称交流会、实际上却是脱衣大战的淫乱比赛中，菲特将与奈叶一较高下！
游戏采用野球拳（石头剪刀布）玩法。
